issues.description: The data type of Course.ratings is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template declare ratings as [Int], but the solution declares ratings as [Double] and then treats ratings as Ints (appending an Int and summing into an Int accumulator). This creates a structural/type mismatch that will cause compile errors in the reference solution and confuse students about the intended type for ratings.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ratings type consistent across all artifacts. The simplest fix is to change the solution to use ratings: [Int] (matching the problem statement and template) and adjust getAverageRating to sum Int ratings and compute Double(sum)/Double(count). Alternatively, if you prefer Double ratings, update the problem statement and template to specify [Double] and ensure addRating accepts/records a Double; also fix the sum/accumulator types accordingly. Ensure the reference solution compiles after the change.
